Title: Azure Active Directory support in Azure Database for MySQL

Body.Content:
Support for Azure Active Directory (Azure AD) integration for Azure Database for MySQL is now in preview. This new integration allows you to securely sign in to their database by using Azure Active Directory and to manage credentials in a central place. For consistent role management, manage database access using Active Directory groups. See more information.

Learn more about Azure Database for MySQL
